augments.name: Cerberus
augments.desc: Gain the <spellName>Hail of Blades</spellName> and <spellName>Press the Attack</spellName> Keystone Runes.

augments.name: Typhoon
augments.desc: Your Attacks fire a bolt at an additional target dealing reduced damage and applying {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} effects.

augments.name: Quest: Urf's Champion
augments.desc:
Requirement: Score @TakedownsNeeded@ takedowns.

Reward: Golden Spatula

augments.name: Stats!
augments.desc: Gain @AmountOfStatAnvils@ %i:StatAnvil% Stat Anvils!

augments.name: Light 'em Up!
augments.desc: Every 4th Attack deals additional <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}.

augments.name: Magic Missile
augments.desc: Dealing damage with an Ability fires @NumberOfMissiles@ magic missiles, each dealing <trueDamage>percent max Health true damage</trueDamage>.

augments.name: Vulnerability
augments.desc:
Your Item and damage over time effects can Critically Strike.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@% Crit chance.

augments.name: Numb to Pain
augments.desc: @MeleeReduction*100@% of damage you take instead happens over @BleedDuration@ seconds (@RangedReduction*100@% for ranged champions).

augments.name: Augmented Power
augments.desc: Increase the damage done by your augments and items by @DamageAmp@.

augments.name: Symphony of War
augments.desc: Gain the <spellName>Lethal Tempo</spellName> and <spellName>Conqueror</spellName> Keystone Runes.

augments.name: Twice Thrice
augments.desc: Every @ProcCadence@ attacks, your {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} effects trigger a second time.

augments.name: Bravest of the Brave
augments.desc: Increase future augment offerings by @tierValueIncrease@ tier. If the augments were already Prismatic tier, gain a bonus @GoldAmount@ gold.

augments.name: Fallen Aegis
augments.desc:
Start combat with a Black Shield for @ShieldDuration@s.

Black Shield blocks Magic Damage and Immobilizing effects.

augments.name: Soul Siphon
augments.desc:
Heal for @HealPercentage*100@% of damage done by Critical Strikes.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@% Crit chance.

augments.name: Gamba Anvil
augments.desc:
Gain +%i:goldCoins%@GoldBonus@ gold and reduce the price of all anvils.

Prismatic Anvils: -%i:goldCoins%@PrismaticCostReduction@ gold
Legendary Anvils: -%i:goldCoins%@LegendaryCostReduction@ gold
Stat Anvils: -%i:goldCoins%@StatCostReduction@ gold

Items acquired from anvils resell for -%i:goldCoins%500 gold less.

augments.name: Dual Wield
augments.desc:
When you Attack, fire a bolt that deals @AttackReduction*100@% damage and applies your {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} effects at @OnHitMod*100@% effectiveness.

Gain @AttackSpeed*100@% total Attack Speed.

augments.name: Deathtouch
augments.desc: Attacking enemy champions grants permanent <keywordMajor>Cursed Power</keywordMajor> and deal additional <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> based on your <keywordMajor>Cursed Power</keywordMajor>.

augments.name: Goredrink
augments.desc: Gain <lifeSteal>@Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp</lifeSteal>.

augments.name: Quest: Rite Of The Forge God
augments.desc:
Requirement: Purchase @AnvilsReqToComplete@ Item Anvils.

Reward: All of your items become Masterwork, increasing their stats by @ItemPercentAmp*100@%.

augments.name: Scopiest Weapons
augments.desc: Gain @RangeIncrease@ Attack Range.

augments.name: escAPADe
augments.desc: Convert <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP> to <scaleAD>Bonus Attack Damage</scaleAD>. Gain <scaleAD>@ADAmp*100@% Attack Damage</scaleAD>.

augments.name: Firebrand
augments.desc: Your Attacks apply an infinitely stacking <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}, dealing damage over time.

augments.name: Flashy
augments.desc: Your <spellName>Flash</spellName> has @MaxAmmo@ Ammo and a @FlashCooldown@ second Cooldown.

augments.name: Nesting Doll
augments.desc:
Gain @BonusLives@ additional Revives, and begin reviving yourself after you die.

When you Revive Knockback enemies around you, and come back smaller with reduced max Health.

augments.name: Tap Dancer
augments.desc:
Your Attacks grant you @MSPerHit@ Move Speed {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}.

Gain Attack Speed equal to @MSToASConversion*10000@% of your Move Speed.

augments.name: Fan the Hammer
augments.desc: When you Attack, fire @AdditionalBolts@ bolts that each deal <physicalDamage>physical damage</physicalDamage> and applies your {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}.

augments.name: Hold Very Still
augments.desc:
Gain Guerrilla Warfare.

Not moving causes you to turn Invisibile until you move. Exiting this Invisibility, causes your next attack to deal bonus magic damage.

augments.name: It's Critical
augments.desc: Gain <crit>%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@% Crit chance</crit>.

augments.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
augments.desc: Gain @AmountOfStatAnvils@ %i:StatAnvil% Stat Anvils!

augments.name: Deft
augments.desc: Gain %i:scaleAS% @AttackSpeed*100@% <speed>Attack Speed</speed>.

augments.name: Leg Day
augments.desc: Gain <speed>@MovementSpeed@ Movement Speed</speed> and <speed>@SlowResist*100@% Slow Resist</speed>.

augments.name: Energetic
augments.desc: Gain <keyword>Energized</keyword> @EnergizeAmpMovementCharge*100@% quicker. Triggering <keyword>Energized</keyword> fires a <keywordMajor>Magic Missile</keywordMajor>, dealing up to <trueDamage>@MaxHealthDamagePerMissile*100@% max Health true damage</trueDamage> based on distance traveled.

augments.name: Mystic Punch
augments.desc: {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} reduce the cooldown of your abilities by @CooldownRefund@ seconds %i:scaleCooldown%.

augments.name: Giant Slayer
augments.desc: Become tiny, gain <speed>Move Speed</speed>, and bonus damage to champions based on how much larger they are than you.

augments.name: Transmute: Prismatic
augments.desc: Gain a random <keywordMajor>%i:Augment% Prismatic Augment</keywordMajor>.

augments.name: Transmute: Gold
augments.desc: Gain a random <keywordMajor>%i:Augment% Gold Augment</keywordMajor>.

augments.name: Stats on Stats!
augments.desc: Gain @AmountOfStatAnvils@ %i:StatAnvil% Stat Anvils!

augments.name: Lightning Strikes
augments.desc:
Gain @TotalASValue*100@% total Attack Speed.

At @Breakpoint1@ Attacks per second, deal additional magic damage {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}.

augments.name: Draw Your Sword
augments.desc:
You are now melee.

Gain Attack Damage, Health, Attack Speed, Lifesteal, and Move Speed based on how much Attack Range you lost.

augments.name: Blunt Force
augments.desc: Gain %i:scaleAD% <scaleAD>@ADAmp*100@% Attack Damage</scaleAD>.

augments.name: Aim for the Head
augments.desc:
Your Critical Strike Chance is capped at @CritChanceCeiling*100@%. Convert @CritChanceToDamageRatio*100@% of Critical Strike Chance above @CritChanceCeiling*100@% into Critical Strike Damage.

Gain @CritChanceBonus*100@% Critical Strike Chance and @CritDamageBonus*100@% Critical Strike Damage.

augments.name: Shrink Ray
augments.desc: Your Attacks reduce the target's damage and size by @DamageReduction*100@% {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}.

augments.name: Warmup Routine
augments.desc:
Gain the Warmup Routine Summoner Spell.

Channel your inner dancer to increase your damage by 2% per second, up to @MaxStacks@% max.

augments.name: Vanish
augments.desc:
Gain the Vanish Summoner Spell.

Vanish turns you Invisible.

augments.name: Self Destruct
augments.desc: Every @BombDelay@ seconds <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor>, attach a bomb to yourself, it explodes, dealing <trueDamage>massive true damage</trueDamage> and <status>Knocking Up</status> nearby enemies.

augments.name: Serve Beyond Death
augments.desc:
The first time you would die each round, instead return to full Health, decaying over time.

Taking down an enemy champion while your Health is decaying stops the decay.

augments.name: Undying Guard
augments.desc: Upon reviving with Cultivation of War, Zaahen deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks all targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created and gains a brief burst of movement speed.

augments.name: Quantum Computing
augments.desc:
Periodically Autocast a massive slash around you, dealing physical damage.

Enemies hit by the outer edge are Slowed, take additional damage, and heal you.

augments.name: Demon's Dance
augments.desc: Gain the Fleet Footwork and Grasp of the Undying Keystone Runes.

augments.name: Defensive Maneuvers
augments.desc:
Gain the Defensive Maneuvers Summoner Spell.

Defensive Maneuvers Casts both Summoner Barrier and Heal on your team.

augments.name: Transmute: Chaos
augments.desc: Gain <keywordMajor>@AugmentsToGrantToolTipOnly@ random %i:Augment%Augments</keywordMajor>.

augments.name: Chauffeur
augments.desc:
You are attached to your ally and can't move on your own.

Your bonus Move Speed is also granted to your ally, and you gain Ability Haste and Attack Speed.

augments.name: Marksmage
augments.desc: Your Attacks deal additional <physicalDamage>physical damage</physicalDamage> equal to <scaleAP>@APRatio*100@% Ability Power</scaleAP>.

augments.name: Light Warden
augments.desc: Every few seconds, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a warding light, <shield>Shielding</shield> yourself and allies it passes through before returning, repeating the effect.
